findings.title: Abstract lacks the continuation comparison baseline
findings.evidence: Continuations are varied independently and conductivity/heat-capacity holding has opposite effects, but holding the last table value and final-slope linear continuation are undefined in the abstract.
affected_claims: qualitative direction of central controlled continuation contrast
findings.consequence: A reader cannot determine the comparison from the abstract alone and may interpret holding as a whole-range constant property.
findings.minimum_repair: Define linear continuation of the final table slope versus holding the final tabulated value above each endpoint; retain fixed source and phase law.

findings.title: Coordinate enthalpy transport discretization is undisclosed
findings.evidence: Frozen Methods gives diffusion face coefficients and acceptance checks but omits exponential convection and current-coefficient stencil assembly. Executed source lines 373-377 use ExponentialConvectionTerm recreated after D updates; line 811 saves that scheme. Selected axial-face Pe is approximately 4.44-5.77.
findings.consequence: The article omits a consequential part of the numerical recipe; the omission does not establish incorrect outputs.
findings.minimum_repair: Name exponential convection and coefficient-dependent stencil updates in the appendix and identify the exact execution recipe in reproduction materials; verify selected run config before naming nonlinear solver options.
findings.missing_evidence: Exact selected nonlinear recipe if that additional detail is named; existing executed code supports the scheme repair.

findings.title: Plotkowski experimental grain comparison can be allocated to both material/process pairs
findings.evidence: The sentence groups geometry verification, solidification calculations and experimental grain comparison for AlSi10Mg laser and IN718 electron-beam cases. The original gives experiments for IN718 EBM only; numerical verification includes both.
affected_claims: experimental validation scope in cited thermal-to-grain example
findings.consequence: The wording can imply experimental grain evidence for an AlSi10Mg laser case that was numerically verified.
findings.minimum_repair: Separate both numerical cases from the IN718 electron-beam experimental comparison, preserving the multi-line hatch-progression condition.

findings.title: Conclusion implies an identical B/C field and a predetermined future validation outcome
findings.evidence: The time relation is said to follow from the same quasi-steady field, although B/C have respective fields; future material data and an aligned trajectory would establish physical correspondence.
findings.consequence: Ambiguous field identity and presupposed validation outcome overstate otherwise correctly bounded calculations.
findings.minimum_repair: Use respective quasi-steady fields and state that future aligned evidence would test or assess physical correspondence.
findings.missing_evidence: No evidence needed for wording repair; actual physical validation remains future work.

findings.title: AI declaration does not document extent of human oversight
findings.evidence: Declaration names OpenAI Codex and purposes but not oversight. The official June2026 Elsevier policy says authors should document tool name, purpose and extent of oversight.
findings.consequence: Pre-submission disclosure remains incomplete; numerical/scientific disposition is unaffected.
findings.minimum_repair: Add a factual human-author oversight statement when confirmed. Do not invent completed human review; exact recommended template wording is not mandatory.
findings.missing_evidence: Extent of actual human author oversight
